name: Mealime Pro
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Mealime Pro, plan meals from user-entered recipes and create a combined shopping list. The hard boundary is licensed recipe catalog, nutrition data, retailer links, mobile apps, and personalization, plus sync, integrations, and household adoption.
